zh:
战斗已暂停。
先观察弹幕节奏，再回到战场吧。
en:
The battle is paused.
Study the rhythm of the barrage, then dive back in.

zh: W / S · A / D 音量  -  Esc / Z 继续  -  X 返回标题
en: W / S · A / D Volume  -  Esc / Z Resume  -  X Title

zh: 短暂整备后将自动进入下一关。
en: The next stage begins automatically after a short break.

zh: Z 重新挑战  -  Esc 返回标题
en: Z Retry  -  Esc Back to Title

zh: A / D / W / S 选择   Z 确认   Shift 刷新卡池（剩余 %d 次）
en: A / D / W / S Select   Z Confirm   Shift Reroll (%d left)

zh: 前方火力均衡，拥有稳定的结界灵击。
en: Balanced forward fire with a steady barrier bomb.

zh: 散射范围更广，灵击会卷起风暴并吸附道具。
en: Wider spread shot. Its bomb whips up a storm that pulls in items.

zh: 前方集中贯穿火力，灵击擅长压制 Boss。
en: Focused piercing forward fire. Its bomb excels at pressuring bosses.

zh: 通关后解锁的持续挑战
en: A nonstop challenge unlocked after clearing the game

zh:
暂无无尽记录。
进入无尽模式并坚持更久吧。
en:
No endless records yet.
Jump into Endless Mode and hold out as long as you can.

zh: 无尽模式 第 %d 波
波次越高，敌人越强；高波次可能出现双 Boss
en: Higher waves mean tougher foes - twin bosses may appear
The higher the wave, the denser the judgment.
Lattice wheels and homing shots press in together.

zh: 继续躲，我会把路一条条关掉。
en: Keep dodging. I'll close your paths one by one.

zh: 收束扇形与坠幕封死中场。
en: Converging fans and falling curtains seal the midfield.

zh: 你的空隙，只是我故意留下的审判间隔。
en: Your openings are just pauses in judgment I left on purpose.

zh: 第 %d 波结束，敌人会继续增强。
en: Wave %d cleared. The enemies will keep getting stronger.

zh: 连续挑战无限波次。每轮奖励后敌人继续变强，甚至会出现双 Boss。
en: Endless waves that grow stronger after each reward. Twin bosses may appear.

zh: 按顺序挑战五个关卡，通向完整结局。
en: Clear all five stages in order to reach the true ending.

zh: 射击间隔 %.3f 秒 -> %.3f 秒
后续火力档位额外获得 1 个支援机位。
en: +1 option drone at every power tier.

zh: 额外获得 1 个灵击，并补强翻盘能力。
en: Gain 1 extra bomb for a stronger comeback.

zh: 额外获得 1 条命；若已接近满命则改为分数奖励。
en: Gain 1 extra life. Gives score instead at max lives.

zh: 扩大道具吸附范围与自动回收线。
en: Wider item magnet and a lower auto-collect line.

zh: 提升擦弹与道具结算的分数收益。
en: Grazing and item pickups score more.

zh: 获得 +12 Power、+6% 射速与 +8% 伤害。
全方位进攻型史诗强化。
获得 +1 命、+1 灵击；若已接近上限则转为大量分数。
en: +1 life and +1 bomb. Becomes a big score bonus at the cap.

zh: 高压环境下的保命型史诗强化。
en: An epic survival upgrade for high-pressure fights.
Get ready for the next wave
You broke through the final border

zh: 短暂整备后进入下一关
en: A short break, then on to the next stage

zh: 无尽 第 %d 波  x%.2f

en: A trial across a sea of neon stars

zh: 边界守望者 · 星界秘主

en: Sentinel at the edge of the astral realm

zh: 先试着跟上我的星轨吧。
en: First, try to keep up with my star trails.
A closing cage of moon petals
The moonlight will seal your escape for me.

zh: 每一道折光，都会成为新的边界。
en: Every refracted ray becomes a new border.
The final onslaught of the falling-star border

zh: 把你的退路与天穹一起压碎。
en: I'll crush your escape along with the sky itself.

zh: 开场波次已突破——选择一项加护。
en: Opening wave cleared - choose a blessing.

zh: 交错波次与环形弹同步出现
en: Crossing waves arrive alongside ring barrages

zh: 星轨战线已稳住——挑选你的下一项成长。
en: The star-trail front holds - pick your next upgrade.

zh: 高压波次已清空——领取一项强化。
en: High-pressure wave cleared - claim an upgrade.

zh: 这片边界的星光有点太吵了……你就是在操纵这场弹幕的人？
en: The starlight on this border is far too noisy... Are you the one conducting this barrage?

zh: 访客啊，若想穿过星界边缘，就用你的轨迹证明自己。
en: Visitor, if you wish to cross the astral edge, prove yourself with your flight path.

zh: 那我就不客气了。先把你的符卡拆开，再去下一层。
en: Then I won't hold back. I'll tear your spell cards apart, then move on to the next layer.

zh: 穿行熔色极光与磁暴回廊
en: Through molten auroras and magnetic-storm corridors

zh: 熔炉守卫 · 炼狱魔王

en: Keeper of the furnace on the magnetic-storm border
A probing press of magnetized blossoms
The furnace core is only just warming up.
An aurora lattice seals the corridor

zh: 极光会把你的每一步都记录下来。
en: The aurora will record your every step.

zh: 把星火压进熔炉，再让它们全部向你倾倒。
en: I'll press starfire into the furnace, then pour it all down on you.

zh: 边界坍缩前的最终熔断
en: The final meltdown before the border caves in

zh: 边界一旦塌陷，就连回旋的余地也不会留下。
en: Once the border caves in, there won't be any room left to maneuver.

zh: 曲线弹与纵向幕墙开始叠加
en: Curving shots begin to stack with vertical curtains

zh: 极光遭遇战已结束——选择一项强化。
en: Aurora skirmish over - choose an upgrade.

zh: 磁暴幕墙开始与旋转花瓣交错
en: Magnetic-storm walls now cross with spinning petals

zh: 熔炉战线已击穿——选择你的下一项优势。
en: The furnace front is broken - choose your next edge.

zh: 风暴格阵已粉碎——收下一项奖励。
en: The storm lattice is shattered - take a reward.

zh: 极光后面居然是熔炉……难怪第二关的弹幕这么烫。
en: A furnace behind the aurora... no wonder the bullets here run so hot.

zh: 能走到这里，已经值得夸奖。但边界坍缩前，你一步也别想再往前。
en: Making it this far deserves praise. But before the border collapses, you won't take one more step.

zh: 那就看看是你的炉火更凶，还是我的避弹线更稳。
en: Then let's see which is stronger: your furnace fire, or my dodging line.

zh: 穿过崩塌要塞的边缘，攀上残垣之巅。
en: Skirt the crumbling fortress and climb to the summit of its ruins.

zh: 要塞裁定者 · 夜垣向量
破碎边界王冠的看守者。
en: Warden of the shattered Border Crown.

zh: 废墟核心绽开，螺旋花瓣层层展开。
en: The ruined core blooms, unfurling spiral petals layer by layer.

zh: 你的道路，止于王冠开始之处。
en: Your road ends where the crown begins.

zh: 冻结的线条封锁整片天空。
en: Frozen lines seal off the entire sky.

zh: 你绘出的每一道回避轨迹，都已落在我的格阵之中。
en: Every dodge you trace already lies within my lattice.

zh: 要塞碎片如同锻造群星般倾泻而下。
en: Fortress shards rain down like freshly forged stars.

zh: 那就让这片废墟来锤炼你的勇气吧。
en: Then let these ruins temper your courage.

zh: 整座堡垒折叠成最后一道压制之墙。
en: The whole fortress folds into one final wall of pressure.

zh: 现在，亲眼看着整条边界一同坠落吧。
en: Now watch the entire border fall with your own eyes.

zh: 外环已突破——选择新的锋芒。
en: Outer ring breached - choose a new edge.

zh: 交叉火力与回旋哨戒开始收束战场。
en: Crossfire and circling sentries close in on the field.

zh: 轨道战线已稳住——领取新的强化。
en: Orbital front secured - claim a new upgrade.

zh: 重装守卫将层层环阵刻入通道。
en: Heavy guards carve ring after ring into the passage.

zh: 要塞封锁已破——选择下一项优势。
en: Lockdown broken - choose your next advantage.

zh: 两翼风暴交错收缩，整条通道被挤压闭合。
en: Storms on both flanks cross and contract, squeezing the passage shut.

zh: 最终通道已打通——在 Boss 前收下最后一项加护。
en: Final passage open - take one last blessing before the boss.

zh: 原来这就是边界的顶端……难怪下面的一切都想拦住我。
en: So this is the top of the border... no wonder everything below tried to stop me.

zh: 所有断裂的轨迹，最终都会回归王冠。把你的也展示给我看。
en: Every broken trajectory returns to the crown in the end. Show me yours.

zh: 那我就亲手在整片废墟中劈出一条新路。
en: Then I'll carve a new path through these ruins myself.
Stage 4 · Court of the Eclipsed Crown

zh: 攀上边界最终崩塌的王座。
en: Ascend to the throne where the border finally crumbles.

zh: 蚀冕君主 · 星终阿斯特拉
en: Eclipse Monarch · Astra of Star's End

zh: 破碎边界背后的最终意志。
en: The final will behind the shattered border.

zh: 高速镜像环阵覆盖整个中场。
en: High-speed mirrored rings blanket the midfield.

zh: 别再向上了，王冠早已选好了属于它的天空。
en: Climb no further. The crown has already chosen its sky.

zh: 幕墙与格线一同封死所有通路。
en: Curtain walls and grid lines seal every route.

zh: 我会把你以为安全的每条路线全部折断。
en: I will snap every route you thought was safe.

zh: 锻造之星穿过收拢幕面，成排坠落。
en: Forged stars pierce the closing curtain and fall in rows.

zh: 那就让你的勇气，在彻底的压迫里被炼成吧。
en: Then let your courage be forged under absolute pressure.

zh: 王座本身会化作最后一道弹幕之墙轰然坠下。
en: The throne itself becomes a final wall of bullets and comes crashing down.

zh: 见证整条边界在最后一次爆发中终结吧。
en: Witness the whole border end in one final burst.

zh: 外环冕线已碎——选择新的锋芒。
en: Outer crown line shattered - choose a new edge.

zh: 镜像与哨戒一同向内折叠通道。
en: Mirrors and sentries fold the passage inward.

zh: 中层冕路已经打开——挑一项更稀有的强化。
en: The middle crown road is open - pick a rarer upgrade.

zh: 分层弧幕与延迟爆发一同压缩屏幕空间。
en: Layered arcs and delayed bursts squeeze the screen.

zh: 内环冕面已裂——不妨刷新寻找更强的机会。
en: The inner crown is cracked - try a reroll for something stronger.

zh: 沉重的侧翼风暴与镜像雷阵同时逼近。
en: Heavy flank storms and mirrored mine fields close in at once.

zh: 王座长廊已开——在终局前收下最后一手强化。
en: Throne hall open - take one last upgrade before the finale.

zh: 原来这里就是王冠真正的中心。
en: So this is the true heart of the crown.

zh: 你侥幸穿过的每一道轨迹，都只是通向我的走廊。
en: Every path you were lucky enough to survive was only a corridor leading to me.

zh: 那我就用最后一条轨迹，把整座王座一并击碎。
en: Then I'll use my last trajectory to shatter this whole throne.

zh: 踏入边界尽头，迎战一切轨迹的终点。
en: Step to the end of the border and face where every trajectory ends.

zh: 终界裁决者 · 星穹终钥
en: Final Arbiter · Keystone of the Heavens

zh: 守在一切弹道尽头的最终门扉。
en: The last gate at the end of every bullet's path.

zh: 全屏格轮与边角压线同步推进。
en: Screen-wide lattice wheels advance with corner-hugging lines.

zh: 终界之前，任何路线都只会变成囚笼。
en: Before the final border, every route becomes a cage.

zh: 追身收束与高压坠幕同时审判。
en: Homing convergence and crushing curtains pass judgment together.

zh: 你所躲开的，不过是我尚未落下的判决。
en: What you dodged was only a verdict I had yet to hand down.

zh: 整片场地开始被层层坍缩挤压。
en: The whole field is crushed by collapse after collapse.

zh: 当边界开始收缩，连喘息都会成为奢望。
en: When the border closes in, even a breath becomes a luxury.

zh: 最终审判覆盖整个天穹，所有空隙尽数闭合。
en: The final judgment covers the heavens, and every gap seals shut.

zh: 来吧，在终点前证明你的最后一条轨迹。
en: Come, prove your final trajectory before the end.

zh: 终界前哨已破——先稳住你的节奏。
en: Final outpost broken - steady your rhythm first.

zh: 高压扇面与延迟雷阵开始联锁。
en: Heavy fans and delayed mine fields begin to interlock.

zh: 交叉压制已被撕开——拿一项更狠的强化。
en: The crossfire is torn open - grab a fiercer upgrade.

zh: 纵列坠幕与追身扇形开始封死中路。
en: Falling columns and homing fans start sealing the center lane.

zh: 终钥回廊已穿透——如果不满意，记得刷新。
en: Keystone Corridor pierced - not satisfied? Remember to reroll.

zh: 双侧崩流开始把整片场地推向中心。
en: Collapsing tides from both sides push the field toward the center.

zh: 终界门扉已开——在最终 Boss 前做最后整备。
en: The final gate is open - prepare yourself for the final boss.

zh: 原来边界尽头，连天空都会像门一样合上。
en: So at the end of the border, even the sky closes like a door.

zh: 你走到这里，便该明白——所有轨迹最终都归我裁决。
en: Having come this far, you should understand - every trajectory is mine to judge.

zh: 那我就用最后一次闪避，把你的终点也一起改写。
en: Then with one last dodge, I'll rewrite your ending too.

zh: 调整音乐与音效的音量。
en: Set the music and sound effect levels.

zh: W / S 选择  -  A / D 调节  -  V / Esc 返回
en: W / S Select  -  A / D Adjust  -  V / Esc Back

zh: 按 M 随时全部静音
en: Press M at any time to mute everything

zh: 已静音  -  按 M 恢复
